identity.name: Mille Miglia Classic
identity.one_liner: The 40.5mm Mille Miglia chronograph — the watch Chopard has made as the official timekeeper of the Mille Miglia vintage car race since 1988.

narrative.story: Chopard has been the official timekeeper of the Mille Miglia (the 1,000-mile Italian vintage car race) since 1988, and the Mille Miglia watch line is the brand's motorsport-heritage entry. The 40.5mm case houses the in-house Chopard 03.05-C automatic chronograph caliber with a 60-hour reserve. The dial design references 1960s racing dashboards — the tire-tread strap and the race-route map on the caseback are Mille Miglia signatures. The Mille Miglia is the most-cited Chopard chronograph and the watch a collector cites when they want a motorsport watch from a brand that actually races.
narrative.collector_notes: Chopard co-president Karl-Friedrich Scheufele drives the Mille Miglia every year. The 03.05-C is a COSC-certified chronometer.
